searchText: Hi all, we recently merged changes into consensus-specs to simplify client implementation efforts: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5566. Please take a look and share any feedback; feel free to open PRs with amendments/improvements. cc: <@531934490826768418> , <@1506349991692734646>, <@688748669268132001> Gloas is progressing well and becoming increasingly stable; as such, I propose that we set a target date for an execution proofs devnet based on Gloas. It would be good if PandaOps could support provisioning the infra to run the devnet. Let's discuss and align on a date that works for everyone's workloads. cc: <@774033563732541451>, <@531934490826768418>, <@688748669268132001>, <@1506349991692734646>, <@335401151711412224>, <@199561711278227457>, <@427491045308235776> do we need a separate devnet for this? devnet-8 is long lived and we can just add a few nodes that run optional proofs. additionally in a month we will have sepolia going through the fork and we can just run optional proofs there and be able to test gloas + large state at the same time. No we don’t need a separate devnet for this. I hadn’t considered using devnet-8 but that sounds like a good idea to me awesome, its already live - so whenever you're ready I will discuss with the team to align efforts in regard to getting things in place and then circle back. I think this could be a good opportunity to collaborate with some prover teams to get various teams generating proofs on the testnet as well its also got no heavy state, so proving it should be easier than other networks What’s the block gas limit? 200M with repricings Hmm this may be challenging with current prover performance

excerpts.author: taulepton_
excerpts.content: Gloas is progressing well and becoming increasingly stable; as such, I propose that we set a target date for an execution proofs devnet based on Gloas. It would be good if PandaOps could support provisioning the infra to run the devnet. Let's discuss and align on a date that works for everyone's workloads. cc: <@774033563732541451>, <@531934490826768418>, <@688748669268132001>, <@1506349991692734646>, <@335401151711412224>, <@199561711278227457>, <@427491045308235776>

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content: do we need a separate devnet for this? devnet-8 is long lived and we can just add a few nodes that run optional proofs. additionally in a month we will have sepolia going through the fork and we can just run optional proofs there and be able to test gloas + large state at the same time.

excerpts.content: No we don’t need a separate devnet for this. I hadn’t considered using devnet-8 but that sounds like a good idea to me
